recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reapply the old STU3 required-code shape to the current build; any future return to primitive code or required binding strength should be handled by a new FM decision that explicitly reverses FHIR-31678 and the current FHIR-53200 alignment.
issue_request: FHIR-13675 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by FM and requested changing ClaimResponse.processNote.type, ExplanationOfBenefit.processNote.type, and PaymentReconciliation.processNote.type from CodeableConcept to code because the NoteType binding was required.
initial_application: Three July 2017 Tracker #13675 commits applied the STU3 request: 4b2964d5d2fc996eb4abe68b87d86d42edf89dc1 for ClaimResponse, 4bef5902deebd032c9fa1b8376f0cc7a1d6b9dd9 for ExplanationOfBenefit, and 509ee2161b8a8effb745e6316aa1c10b28c42d59 for PaymentReconciliation. They changed old spreadsheet source rows from CodeableConcept to code and changed examples from CodeableConcept/Coding syntax to primitive code values.
additional_context: FHIR-31678 later changed ClaimResponse and ExplanationOfBenefit processNote.type to CodeableConcept with an extensible binding because primitive code was too limiting. FHIR-53200 later required PaymentReconciliation.processNote to match ClaimResponse, and the combined branch already contains commit 00c8da13bf2c00f4664fbc9580b8e067a47eef75 completing that alignment by changing PaymentReconciliation.processNote.type to CodeableConcept/extensible. The three resources are active in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active StructureDefinition sources consistently define ClaimResponse.processNote.type, ExplanationOfBenefit.processNote.type, and PaymentReconciliation.processNote.type as CodeableConcept with extensible NoteType bindings, so reapplying FHIR-13675 would incorrectly reverse later FM decisions.
